AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: HAdo is a to-do and reminder app whose lists live in Home Assistant or on this device. Operational patterns: use createTask to add a task or reminder to the user's default list, giving a due date and due time when the user mentions one; use addTask instead when the user names one of their lists; use listTodoLists to find out which lists exist. Constraints: only lists the user shows in HAdo can be used, and a due time needs a due date.
